description: Batch chemical lookup + comparison (PubChem) — Look up up to 10 chemicals by name or CAS number in one call (names separated by ;): CID, formula, molecular weight, CAS, InChIKey, XLogP, TPSA, H-bond counts and Lipinski check for each, plus a comparison summary (heaviest, lightest, most lipophilic, most polar, Lipinski pass/fail lists). Source: PubChem (NCBI/NLM). Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: chem_compound_batch
